svg.title: NYC Taxi pipeline data flow
svg.desc: Monthly TLC Parquet files and the taxi zone CSV land in the raw zone, pass a validation gate, are written to the trusted zone one partition per batch, aggregated into curated tables and published as outputs. Rejected rows and blocked batches go to quarantine. Manifest, success markers, batch history and run logs record state.
svg.text: One batch is one service × month file. Counts come from the January–June 2024 run: 24 batches across 4 services.
